note: Task 20 (chunk e7): the jaw. The functions of jaw.html that its README calls normative: the jaw (`update`: the spring toward `target − pull`, the twitches, the tremor, the ring as the floor; the fatigue by the cost of the opening over the endurance skill; the teeth; an order not kept), the mouth (`render`: its height, the hinges' burn, her band's ghost frames, the rest ring, the letters smearing from fatigue 50, the frame's jolt, vignette, ache and saturation, the strain hum; her sprite from below, the foot art; the drool, `spawnDrop`), her moves (`bandNow`, `herMove`), the rest (`askRest`), speech through the opening (speech.ts `speak` with `LABIAL`, `DENTAL`, `VELAR`, `OPEN_*`, `DEGRADE_AT`; `renderMirror`, `onType`, `sendLine`), her hand (`say`), the phases (`begin`, `finish`, `frame`), the state (`fresh`, `st`, `L`, `C`, `pick`, `rand`, `H0`), the sound (`audioInit`, `loadSamples`, `play`, `noise`, `tone`, `SFX`, `strainInit`) and the tables (`STYLES`, `CONTACTS`, the instrument's numbers `MOUTH_H` … `ORDER_GRACE`, the engine's `BEAT`, `JAW_PER`, `JAW_REST`, `REST_MS` = TUNING `jawRestMs`, `REST_DENIED`), and its `LINES` (checked by `lines`: `cardVoice` `jaw.*` by style; her question's pairs are `jaw.ask` rows `question|word` and the stop line `jaw.stop`, both checked word for word by tests/content/cardVoice.test.ts). Module wiring beyond the listed functions (jaw.ts header): `performance`, `setTimeout`, `requestAnimationFrame`, `innerWidth` / `innerHeight` and `Math.random` are the module's own (the scene's frame clock, the mount's timers and frames, the scene's size, the xorshift of speech.ts seeded by fnv1a of the scene and the run: no rng draw; a frame's time earlier than the clock the mount read is never a negative step); `$` names the instrument's elements in the effects layer (under the scene's UI: the stop word's pill is never covered), the scene's input line as `#mouth` and `#inputWrap` (its height, transform, `--ache` and border written through a claim, styleClaims.ts, with its margins keeping its centre), the field as `#cmd`, and the letters, the hinges and the rest ring on the line; her band's ghost frames lie beside the line in its parent. The prototype's top-level listeners are the mount's (`env.listen`): the mouse's height over the document is the jaw (`G.target`, relative to the scene's root); keys typed into the field go through `onType` before the scene's own handler (capture on the root), paste and drop into the field are refused (only typed letters come out of the mouth); Shift asks for a rest only from outside a field or a control (typed into the field it is a capital: ruling O), the right button on the frame or the line always (preventDefault: the field keeps its focus), the left button on the frame focuses the field; Escape and H are the scene's (the stop word is its pill). `LINES` is the prototype's shape filled from `cardVoice` by her lead style (`refreshLines`; a style with no rows of its own takes neutral's, cold is silent and its question has no words: Ruling R); a model-worded cue `deeper` / `suck` / `wider` / `pull_back` for the beat of her move takes that line's place (ruling Q). `S` is the approved defaults (the ring 0.55: no item carries a size) with the run's: the contact by field (`jawContactOf`: an item worn in the mouth is the ring, a contact on her toes her toes), her style's row (`ROW_BY_CUES` for a style the prototype has no row of), the commander's jaw endurance level as the skill, the still form (`env.reduced`, `env.readable`: readable drops every blur). The foot art has no art slot yet (ArtSlotId names none for the jaw): `footLoaded` stays false and her sprite from below stands in, as the README's fallback; the foot's code is ported. Reports (R21–R23): each beat of a running segment, as it ends (the last 300 ms before the segment's end), `bite` with the mean cost of the opening over its frames (a rest's frames cost 0; a beat before the mount the flat 1), `pointer`; a touch of the teeth at once as `bite` with `part: 'teeth'`; a rest as `ask_rest` (one a segment, `restWaits`). The fatigue is the engine's gauge at each segment's start. The line sent is the heard line (`heardLine`); the clear share is the instrument's summary only (`digest()`, UI). Not ported (README: prototype only): the panel, the start overlay, the summary card, the debug readout, the `__` hooks (`_jaw` is the tests' and the shots' hook), `setReply` and the act lines, her schedule (`STYLES[].every`, `.ask`: the engine's `jawOrders`), the session length, her release at the limit (the engine's boundary). CSS (checked by the shots): the prototype's styles under `.alius-jaw` and on the line (her lines in her hand at 44 px × her hand's measured scale, wrapping inside the frame at 40 %; the mouth is the scene's line, its width and its glass; the letters in the scene's font at its size).

No context yet (before the player's first gesture, or no sound): nothing is built, and the frame tries again.

differences.reason: Wiring (ruling D): the recordings are the extension's own files (`SAMPLE_URLS`: `assets/sounds/breath-in-out.mp3` and `assets/sounds/ha/cloth1–4.ogg`, CC0, the prototype's), fetched and decoded once by the sample layer (`samples.preload`); `A.buf[key]` reads the layer's decoded buffer (null until it is decoded: the prototype's synthesised fallback plays meanwhile, as its `play` returns null).

Wiring (R23): the line sent is the heard one. The prototype writes it into its own `#reply` (with `meant:` under it, README: the port's call); here the scene's reply block is the model's, so `heardLine` puts what came out into the field just before the scene's own Enter sends it (a swipe or a regenerate never distorts it again), and keeps the share of clear letters in the instrument's summary only (`R.kept`, never a number for the model or the transcript). The commander knows what was meant: it is not shown.

Wiring (R22, README: her schedule is prototype only): her move is the engine's plan, played as its beat begins (`R.move`: `order` / `orderMs` / `ask`, planned by hash). `moveR` gives the prototype's draw the value of the planned move (her toes: deeper 0, back 0.4, suck 0.6, wider 0.9; the ring: her question 0, wider 1), so every branch runs as written; an order lasts the plan's `orderMs` (`orderLen`, the prototype's own span without one); the next move is the plan's, not `nextMove`. Her 40 % chance to speak as she pulls back and her 45 % question 1.6 s into "wide." stay hers (the module's xorshift: no rng draw).

differences.reason: Wiring: the engine reads one rest a segment (the first `ask_rest`; it also ends that segment's beats), so `restWaits` reports the rest asked (`ask_rest` on this beat, `pointer` when the right button asked, ruling O) and lets one through a segment; another asked in the same segment, or between segments, waits for the next one and is asked as it begins. So her answer, granted unless cruel or vindictive (the prototype's `REST_DENIED`, the engine's rule), is always the engine's.

Wiring: no context yet (before the player's first gesture, or no sound) leaves `A.ctx` null (the prototype makes its own). The summary card is prototype only (README). The act line in `#reply` is not drawn: the scene's reply block is the model's, and the scene itself says what holds the mouth open (the blocking strip).

differences.reason: Wiring: the engine ends the hold, not the instrument: her release at her limit (the prototype's 600 ms / 6 s at fatigue 100) and the session's length (`S.len`, prototype only) are the engine's boundary (the fatigue stays at 100 until it decides, as breath's air stays at 0). Wiring: the drops are drawn in the instrument's canvas, which covers the scene's frame, not the window: the mouth's rect is taken relative to the scene's root (`R.ox`, `R.oy`).

Wiring: the mouth is the scene's own input line, in the scene's column: it opens around its centre where it stands (its height as the prototype's, its centre kept by its margins in `after`), and it is lifted (`R.lift`) only as far as puts its centre `MOUTH_BOTTOM` (the prototype's 96 px) above the frame's bottom, so the mouth wide open and her band stay in the frame as in the prototype; its transform is that lift and the tremble (not the prototype's centring `translate(-50%, 50%)`). Her band's ghost frames are as wide as the line plus 20 px (the prototype's 720 + 20) and centred on it (`R.mouthW`, `R.mouthY`). The debug readout is prototype only (README).
